title: The one-shot compression run
intro: You have a full-precision checkpoint and a GPU hour. Order the LLM Compressor workflow.
prompt: Put the compression workflow in order:

steps.text: Choose the model and a representative calibration dataset
Pick the algorithm — GPTQ (Hessian, compensates error) vs AWQ (protects high-activation weights)
Choose the scheme — W4A16, INT8, FP8 — targeting Linear layers, ignoring lm_head
Run one-shot post-training quantization over ~256 calibration samples
Verify: size on disk, a sample generation, and perplexity vs the base model
Serve the compressed checkpoint directly in vLLM

debrief: Model + data → algorithm → scheme → one-shot → **verify** → serve. The verification step is not optional: the lab's Qwen3-0.6B came out 42% smaller (not the theoretical 75%) with perplexity 32.79 → 35.48 (~8% worse) — numbers you only know by measuring.
